extDescription.message: Brings the Contacts list back to Facebook's right column: Messenger, docked where your friends used to be.

showPanelDesc.message: Who is active now, in the right column. Click someone to chat.

compactDesc.message: Hides Messenger's own top bar inside the panel.

statusActive.message: Changes apply to this tab now.

statusIdle.message: The panel appears on your Facebook home.

tipEsc.message: Widened the panel to read a chat? Press Esc to narrow it.

openMessenger.message: Open Messenger in a new tab

loadFailedHint.message: Check your connection, or reload the extension if you just updated it.

onlyActiveDesc.message: Show only people who are active now in the Contacts list.

pauseHiddenDesc.message: After 5 minutes in a background tab, Messenger inside the panel is unloaded to save CPU and memory. It loads again when you come back. Not used while Notify when active is on for anyone.

openChatFailed.message: Couldn't open Facebook's chat window. You can open the conversation in Messenger.

deleteDescription.message: This deletes your copy of the whole conversation. You can’t undo it. The other participants keep their copies.

deleteFailed.message: Couldn't delete. Open it in Messenger to delete it there.

deleteControlsMissing.message: Couldn't identify Messenger's delete or confirmation control. Open the conversation in Messenger to delete it.

deleteInboxUnavailable.message: The inbox connection was lost. Refresh Facebook and try again.

deleteRowMissing.message: Messenger hasn't loaded this conversation. Open it in Messenger to check.

deleteUnverified.message: The delete action was sent, but its result couldn't be verified. Check Messenger before trying again.

bulkUnsaveBody.message: They are removed from Saved one by one, a few seconds apart. You can't undo this in bulk: to save a post again you have to find it.

bulkReactionsBody.message: Your likes and reactions will be removed from the selected posts. You can't undo this action.

bulkCommentsBody.message: The selected comments will be permanently deleted. You can't undo this action.

bulkResting.message: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ done. Taking a short break to stay under Facebook's limits…

bulkBlocked.message: Stopped: Facebook showed a limit or security message. Wait before trying again.

bulkUnidentified.message: Stopped because a Facebook control or selection could not be identified. Check the page before continuing.

bulkUnverified.message: Stopped: the last action could not be confirmed. Check the page before continuing.

bulkDailyLimit.message: Stopped: today's limit of 200 actions is reached.

bulkHint.message: Keep this tab open while it runs. You can use other tabs.

hubDesc.message: A button at the bottom left of Facebook with quick settings and the clean-up tools, such as unsaving many items at once.

hubReactionsHint.message: In Activity Log, open Comments and reactions, then Likes and reactions.

hubCommentsHint.message: In Activity Log, open Comments and reactions, then Comments.
